crew_voice_announce_background: The microphone was released because Atlas went to the background. Transcribing what you said.
crew_voice_announce_cap: Dictation stopped at the {minutes} minute limit. Transcribing what you said.
crew_voice_announce_device_lost: The microphone stopped working. Transcribing what was recorded.
crew_voice_announce_inserted: Dictated text added to the message. Press Escape to undo.
crew_voice_announce_started: Dictation started. The microphone is on.
crew_voice_denied: Atlas does not have access to the microphone. Allow it in the system settings, then dictate again.
crew_voice_empty: No speech was recognized. Nothing was added.
crew_voice_hint_tap: Press again to finish. Esc cancels.
crew_voice_key_hint: How the microphone button and {shortcut} work in the message box.
crew_voice_key_tap: Press to start, press to stop
crew_voice_no_device: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
crew_voice_settings_status_hint: Dictation sends the audio to this crew server, which recognizes it and deletes it right after.
crew_voice_switch_hint: Only the owner can change it. Off: every dictation is refused.
crew_voice_unavailable: The microphone is not available in this window.
crew_voice_unsupported: This crew server cannot transcribe yet. Update it to dictate.
